sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Live translate — Gemini API model documentation
sources.evidence: Names the exact preview endpoint; specifies audio input, translated audio and transcript output, 131072 input tokens, 65536 output tokens, and no thinking or function calling. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact endpoint specification table provides no total, active or audio-component parameter count.

sources.title: Live translation with Gemini Live API
sources.evidence: The exact model translates speech across 70+ languages. The guide restricts input to audio and use to translation without tools or instructions. Its v1beta BidiGenerateContent WebSocket example requests AUDIO and optional input/output transcription.

sources.title: Fluid, natural voice translation with Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
sources.evidence: June 9, 2026 announcement explicitly releases Gemini 3.5 Live Translate that day in public developer preview through Gemini Live API and Google AI Studio; describes speech-to-speech translation across more than 70 languages. Reopened October 27, 2026: no model-size disclosure or count-bearing base is given. The trillion figure describes words translated across Google products each month, not model parameters.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Audio (Live Translate, Transcribe, Transcribe Live) model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 complete-card review. The August 26 card explicitly names Gemini 3 Pro as the base for Live Translate and refers architecture and training to that card. This is a named model dependency, not merely family resemblance, but neither total, active nor audio-component size is stated. The card describes native audio as an additional output without a numerical component breakdown. The broader audio-and-text input statement differs from the endpoint audio-only restriction.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 complete May 2026 PDF review. The named base is a sparse MoE Transformer with qualitative per-token expert routing. Its model information, architecture and comparisons disclose no numeric total, active count, expert dimensions or audio-component size. It is explicitly a new model, not a modification or fine-tune of a prior model; no earlier known-size base is identified.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The API operates under Google service terms, including restrictions on extracting underlying models or parameter weights. Together with the exact model card's hosted distribution, supports a proprietary, closed-weight classification.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Audio model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 complete September audio-card review. Its distinct Live, extended-thinking and TTS variants also name Gemini 3 Pro as base, without any numeric total, active or audio-component count. There is no retrospective Live Translate size disclosure or activated-parameter comparison column. Its capabilities and identity are not transferred to the assigned translation model.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 complete decoded October 13 card check. Argon is explicitly a new model, not a modification or fine-tune of an earlier model. The architecture and comparison material supply no retrospective Live Translate total, active or component size.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Live Translate — Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
sources.evidence: Documents the same identifier through BidiGenerateContent with audio input/output and optional transcripts, no thinking or function calling. Lists an August 2026 Cloud preview release, later than the explicit June 9 developer API launch.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Audio (Live Translate): Model evaluation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and read the complete two-page exact-model evaluation PDF. It describes translation quality through AutoMQM, initial and word-level latency, and speech naturalness using Gemini Live API outputs. It contains no parameter-size or activated-parameter comparison table.

sources.title: Models.dev exact model record
sources.evidence: Fetched raw TOML underlying the baseline link. It identifies a realtime audio model and links the official API page, guide, card and launch announcement. Used only for provenance and normalization, not as verification of technical claims.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27, 2026 full-text exact-model and parameter review found no retrospective Live Translate numerical size. Parameter occurrences concern task difficulty, weight security and encoded knowledge; comparisons with the Pro base concern safety outcomes rather than total or activated counts.

name.note: Official product name plus the endpoint's explicitly documented Preview stage.

developer.note: Google announces and Google DeepMind documents the model.

family.note: Retain the catalog's normalized family key: the exact Live Translate card explicitly establishes Gemini 3 Pro lineage.

release_date.note: The June 9 announcement states the public developer preview starts that day. Cloud's August preview is a later distribution launch, not the earliest public release.

open_weights.note: Google documents hosted API/product distribution governed by service terms; no downloadable model weights are offered.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the model's service terms, not the CC BY documentation or Apache code-example licenses.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name/ID total-size, named-base and component searches, reopened original evidence and later primary comparisons found no supported nominal total. The Gemini 3 Pro dependency is explicit and could support a count inference if the base had a published size; none was found. Neither an audio-component count nor a count-bearing backbone is disclosed. Null reflects absent numerical evidence, not an exact tensor-census requirement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-count searches and original/later comparison checks found no numerical per-token active count for Live Translate or its named Pro base. Sparse routing is qualitative, without expert dimensions or routing quantities sufficient for a count. No audio-phase or component active count is published; latency, translated-word volume and context limits are not parameter counts.

architecture.note: The Live Translate architecture section explicitly directs readers to Gemini 3 Pro, whose card specifies a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer. This establishes the architectural class, not identical parameter counts.

context_window.note: Exact endpoint input-token limit. The separate output-token limit is 65536; it is not added to the catalog value.

modalities.note: The endpoint accepts speech and emits translated audio plus optional transcripts. Text output is transcription, not general text-chat generation. Although the broader model card lists audio and text inputs, the exact endpoint page and translation guide explicitly restrict public input to audio.

reasoning.note: The exact endpoint explicitly does not support thinking. Generic family language about reasoning in the shared audio card does not override the endpoint capability.

tool_call.note: Function calling and tools are explicitly unsupported for this translation endpoint.

sources.label: Google DeepMind Gemini 3.5 Audio model card

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer based on Gemini 3 Pro; neither Live Translate nor its named base has a published total or active parameter count in the reviewed sources. Text output denotes transcripts accompanying speech translation. The public endpoint accepts audio only despite the broader model card's audio-and-text input statement. Earliest public preview: June 9, 2026; Cloud's August date is later platform availability.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit: retain explicit null total and active counts after fresh exact-model/ID, named-base and component searches, reopened API/launch/card/evaluation evidence, and later 3.8 Audio, Argon and safety-report comparisons. The explicit Gemini 3 Pro dependency is valid lineage but supplies no numerical size. No audio-component or phase count was found. All unrelated assessments and translation-preview identity are preserved.
